name: supported-formats
summary: The complete set of molecular, map, session, image and geometry formats PyMOL can read and/or write, dispatched by filename extension.

name: load
summary: Universal reader for molecules, maps, sessions and other content, with format guessed from the file extension.
signature: load(filename, object='', state=0, format='', finish=1, discrete=-1, quiet=1, multiplex=None, zoom=-1, partial=0, mimic=1, object_props=None, atom_props=None)

name: loadall
summary: Load every file matching a server-side glob pattern, optionally grouping the results.

name: load_traj
summary: Append trajectory frames as extra states onto an already-loaded molecular object.
signature: load_traj(filename, object='', state=1, format='', interval=1, average=1, start=1, stop=-1, max=-1, selection='all', image=1, shift='[0.0,0.0,0.0]', plugin='')

name: load_coords
summary: API-only injection of an Nx3 coordinate array into a selection in atom-sorted order.

name: load_coordset
summary: API-only injection of coordinates into an object in original (source) atom order.

name: load_object
summary: Developer-level loader that ingests an in-memory Python object (model, CGO, callback, brick, map).
signature: load_object(type, object, name, state=0, finish=1, discrete=0, quiet=1, zoom=-1)

name: load_embedded
summary: Load data declared inline in a .pml script via the embed directive.
signature: load_embedded(key=None, name=None, state=0, finish=1, discrete=1, quiet=1, zoom=-1, multiplex=-2, object_props=None, atom_props=None)

name: load_model
summary: Load a ChemPy model object into a new PyMOL object (inverse of get_model).

name: load_png
summary: Load a PNG from disk and display it as the current rendered image / movie frame.

name: load_raw
summary: API-only loader for content already in memory, using a temp file only when the format lacks a string loadable.
signature: load_raw(content, format, object='', state=0, finish=1, discrete=-1, quiet=1, multiplex=None, zoom=-1)

name: load_cgo
summary: Load a Compiled Graphics Object (list of floats) as a displayable geometry object.

name: fetch
summary: Download a structure, map or chemical component by accession code from PDB/PDBe/PDBj/EMDB/PubChem/CCD and load it.
signature: fetch(code, name='', state=0, finish=1, discrete=-1, multiplex=-2, zoom=-1, type='', async_=0, path='', file=None, quiet=1)

name: fetch_path
summary: Directory where fetch and download_chem_comp cache downloaded files.

name: download_chem_comp
summary: Download and cache a wwPDB chemical-component-dictionary CIF for a residue/ligand code.

name: save
summary: Universal writer for selections, sessions, maps, alignments, images and geometry, format chosen by extension.
signature: save(filename, selection='(all)', state=-1, format='', ref='', ref_state=-1, quiet=1, partial=0)

name: multisave
summary: Write a multi-entry PDB/CIF file with a HEADER/CRYST block per object so it reloads as separate objects.
signature: multisave(filename, pattern='all', state=-1, append=0, format='', quiet=1)

name: multifilesave
summary: Save each object/state of a selection to a separate placeholder-templated file.
signature: multifilesave(filename, selection='*', state=-1, format='', ref='', ref_state=-1, quiet=1)

name: multifilenamegen
summary: Expand a placeholder filename template into the concrete (filename, selection, state) triples multifilesave would write.

name: get_session
summary: Build the in-memory session dictionary that backs .pse saving.
signature: get_session(names='', partial=0, quiet=1, compress=-1, cache=-1, binary=-1, version=-1)

name: set_session
summary: Restore a session dictionary (or its zlib+pickle bytes) into the current instance, triggering the security wizard on embedded movie commands.

name: session-format
summary: PyMOL's native .pse/.psw pickled-session format, including PNG thumbnail embedding and .psw presentation auto-start.

name: log_open
summary: Open a log file and begin recording every executed command.

name: log
summary: Write one command line into the open log file in pml or python form.

name: log_close
summary: Close the current log file and stop recording.

name: run
summary: Execute a Python or PyMOL-command script file in the running instance.

name: spawn
summary: Launch a Python script in a new thread running concurrently with the interpreter.
The @file.pml directive that inline-includes and executes a PyMOL command script.

name: get_pdbstr
summary: API-only: return PDB text for a selection/state without writing a file.

name: get_fastastr
summary: API-only: return protein/nucleic sequences in FASTA format.

name: get_cifstr
summary: API-only: return an mmCIF string for a selection/state.

name: get_model
summary: API-only: return a ChemPy Indexed model (atoms, bonds, coords) for a selection.

name: read_pdbstr
summary: API-only: load or update a structure from a PDB string with no temp file.
signature: read_pdbstr(contents, oname, state=0, finish=1, discrete=0, quiet=1, zoom=-1, multiplex=-2, object_props=None)

name: read_molstr
summary: API-only: load an MDL MOL structure from a string.
signature: read_molstr(molstr, name, state=0, finish=1, discrete=1, quiet=1, zoom=-1)

name: read_sdfstr
summary: API-only: load an MDL SD (multi-record MOL) structure from a string.
signature: read_sdfstr(sdfstr, name, state=0, finish=1, discrete=1, quiet=1, zoom=-1, multiplex=-2, object_props=None)

name: read_mmodstr
summary: API-only: load a MacroModel structure from a string.

name: read_xplorstr
summary: API-only: load an XPLOR map from a string, bypassing temp files.
signature: read_xplorstr(xplor, name, state=0, finish=1, discrete=0, quiet=1, zoom=-1)
